Brother Khatul

Biography

Brother Khatul leads the Last Shelter and distrusts easy good fortune. He tests Kir with a signet-ring task, accepts him into the brotherhood and works to conceal its existence from imperial scouts. His decisions put the survival and morale of the refuge above straightforward honesty; he knowingly accepts a false ring while keeping that fact quiet. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
